statement: This sketch creates an ethereal collage of overlapping, semi-transparent photographs that drift slowly across the canvas, evoking a sense of fading memories. The images move autonomously with subtle bouncing and drifting motions, while thousands of soft, diffused light motes float gently through the composition. The visual effect suggests a dreamlike atmosphere where past moments linger and shift, creating an immersive experience of nostalgic depth and ambient movement.
